notes: Eval target is this repo's own solution (dotnet-aicraft.sln). The `dotnet aicraft` CLI is installed and runnable. Prompts are grounded in real symbols so old-vs-new skill runs are directly comparable. All prompts are read-only or --dry-run; none mutate the working tree.

evals.name: blast-radius-refs
evals.prompt: I'm about to change the constructor of the DaemonTransportException class in this .NET solution. Before I touch it I need the full blast radius: every place in the solution that references DaemonTransportException, across both src and tests. Give me the complete list with file and line.
evals.expected_output: Uses dotnet aicraft refs (discovering the FQN via symbols first if needed) rather than grep/Glob/Read. Returns the full reference set including both src/ and tests/ locations.

evals.name: call-graph-callers
evals.prompt: There's a helper method BuildTransportError inside DaemonClient. I want to understand its incoming call sites — what calls it? Show me the callers.
evals.expected_output: Uses dotnet aicraft callers (default incoming direction), resolving the FQN of DaemonClient.BuildTransportError. Does not grep for the method name.

evals.name: rename-safety
evals.prompt: I'd like to rename the method IsTransportFailure to IsTransportException across the whole solution. Is that safe, and what exactly would change? Do NOT apply anything yet — I just want to see the impact first.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the FQN (symbols), then runs rename --dry-run and reports the changes[] without applying. Does not perform a manual find/replace.

evals.name: dead-code-scan
evals.prompt: Are there any dead or unused methods in the DotnetAICraft source project (src/DotnetAICraft) that I could safely delete? I want candidates with some confidence signal, not guesses.
evals.expected_output: Uses dotnet aicraft unused (optionally narrowed to the project) and may confirm with refs. Does not attempt to infer dead code by reading files or grepping.
